info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Review Submission API
info.description: The Market Data Review Submission API allows clients to submit reviews related to market data switch operations. This API is designed for financial institutions and market analysts, enabling them to provide feedback on specific market data transactions. By using this endpoint, users can enhance the quality of data by adding valuable insights, which can assist in decision-making and improve service levels. Typical consumers include banking professionals and data analysts who require a structured method to communicate their evaluations.
